pictures.name: YSD1-Gokul-Yard
pictures.prompt: A cowherd village in ancient India in the morning, mud-walled houses with thatched roofs, cows with painted horns, a packed-earth yard. In the middle, baby Krishna, painted in the traditional, reverent style of Indian devotional art, a chubby, radiant toddler of about two with a deep blue complexion, black curls, a small peacock feather in his hair, a little yellow cloth and tiny gold anklets, his face sweet and serene, squats happily in the dirt, a little smudge of earth on his lips. Nearby, a few small village boys point at him, wide-eyed. Soft gold morning light, blue shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.prompt: A courtyard in an ancient Indian cowherd village. pictures.name: YSD4-The-Universe
pictures.prompt: Yashoda, shown with traditional devotional reverence, a warm young village mother in her twenties in an orange and red cotton sari with silver bangles, her hair in a long braid, kneels and gently looks into the open mouth of baby Krishna, painted in the traditional, reverent style of Indian devotional art, a chubby, radiant toddler of about two with a deep blue complexion, black curls, a small peacock feather in his hair, a little yellow cloth and tiny gold anklets, his face sweet and serene. Inside his little mouth, as if through a window, opens a vast glowing cosmos: swirling stars and galaxies, the moon, mountains, oceans, rivers, forests, and far within it a tiny cowherd village with a tiny figure of Yashoda herself. Her face is full of astonished awe. Deep blue and gold, luminous, gentle. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame.
